File surface (read on `origin/main` `62bc12930`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts`:
  - the pre-prompt listing;
  - the "N destructive change(s) will be SKIPPED (re-run with --allow-destructive …)" line (about `:355`);
  - the post-apply "Skipped N destructive change(s) (re-run with --allow-destructive …)" line (about `:696`).
  Before the ownership ceremony verifies, those lines offer a re-run that the drop gate (about `:555`–`:605`) refuses whole. They name the ceremony instead, reading the drop gate's own `ceremonyOrganizationColumnDrops` / `readOrganizationOwnershipMarker`, as PR #24954 (#24925) does for the plan.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/plan.ts`. The plan offers `--allow-destructive` for `sys_comment.reactions`, which `apply` refuses (about `:502`–`:553`), naming `os migrate comment-reactions`. The plan names that command.
  - The reactions gate's predicate is inline in `apply.ts`. It moves into one exported function in `packages/cli/src/utils/`, which `apply` and `plan` both ask. One source; no second inventory.
  - The same goes for `sys_account.issuer`'s gate (about `:471`–`:488`), if the plan offers `--allow-destructive` for it.
- An enumeration pin lists every `apply` drop gate (`sys_account.issuer`, `sys_comment.reactions`, `organization_id`). It asserts that `plan` and `apply`'s pre-prompt listing / skip lines name that gate's remedy for each one, so a new gate cannot reopen the shape.
- ⛔ Hold-offs:
  - every gate's refusal rule and refusal text;
  - the boot's `[schema-drift]` lines (#24956, the engine lane);
  - `--json` documents (unchanged);
  - the exit codes PR #25004 just set;
  - `packages/spec/**`.
- One `@objectstack/cli` changeset at `patch`: printed text of `os migrate plan` / `apply`.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: the human face of `os migrate plan` and `apply` only. No accept set, exit code, refusal or `--json` field moves. The moved predicate is CLI-internal.
Responsibility: this lane's CLI doors (`packages/cli` `migrate plan` / `apply`). No platform path covers it. It reaches every operator on a 17.x database before the ceremony, and every database holding stored comment reactions.
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `apply.ts`, `plan.ts` or `schema-migrate.ts`. All 16 open PRs were read in this act.
- This seat's other cards in flight are disjoint: #24809 (PR #24873) and #24927 (`hook-timeout-override-refusal.test.ts`).
